evidenceBoundary: Existing runtime data are deterministic synthetic reconstructions, not published source observations.

candidates.scientificMessage: Ndel1/GAPDH abundance changes over serum starvation.
candidates.design: Independent WB experiments across ordered time; repeated preparation identity unconfirmed.
candidates.primaryContrast: Trajectory relative to 0 h; no default all-pairs family.
candidates.inference: Descriptive only unless a prespecified time contrast and matching are confirmed.
candidates.graph: Mean ± SEM line with time points; optional experiment traces only with valid identity.
candidates.sampleSize: 3 experiments, 6 time levels; 54 synthetic lower-level rows.

candidates.scientificMessage: Centrosomal Ndel1 intensity changes during serum starvation.
candidates.design: Cross-sectional cells nested in independent imaging sessions.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Independent imaging experiment, approximately n=3; cells are nested.
candidates.graph: Violin/box with raw cells and distinct session summaries.
candidates.sampleSize: 356 synthetic cell rows across 3 sessions and 6 levels.

candidates.scientificMessage: Ndel1 hypomorphism changes ciliation within specific renal compartments.
candidates.design: Independent mice; genotype crossed with three renal categories.
candidates.primaryContrast: WT versus cko within each renal category.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Mouse, approximately n=6; counted objects retain numerator/denominator.
candidates.inference: Three adjusted genotype contrasts or genotype × category model if interaction is primary.
candidates.graph: Grouped mouse-level dots with summary, optionally faceted by renal category.

candidates.scientificMessage: Ndel1 hypomorphism changes cilium length in specific renal compartments.
candidates.design: Cilia nested within mice, crossed by genotype and renal category.
candidates.primaryContrast: WT versus cko within each renal category.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Mouse; current catalog n=20 is unsafe until reconciled with cilium counts.
candidates.inference: Mouse summaries or hierarchical model after identity/count confirmation.
candidates.graph: Raw cilia plus mouse summaries, preferably faceted by renal category.
candidates.sampleSize: 1,342 synthetic cilium rows; true mouse n unresolved.

candidates.scientificMessage: Opto-RhoA selectively increases the RhoA biosensor after illumination.
candidates.design: Longitudinal cells nested in imaging experiments with stable cell identity.
candidates.primaryContrast: Opto-RhoA versus opto-control on a prespecified response summary or trajectory.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Independent imaging experiment, approximately n=3; cells are nested repeated observations.
candidates.inference: Experiment-level response summary or mixed model.
candidates.graph: Mean trajectory with uncertainty and optional faint nested traces.
candidates.sampleSize: 84 synthetic rows across 3 experiments and 7 times.

candidates.scientificMessage: RhoA is the principal tested small-GTPase inducer of Ca²⁺ transients in RPE1.
candidates.design: Independent imaging experiments with responder numerator/denominator across seven constructs.
candidates.primaryContrast: Relevant opto-GTPases versus opto-control; no all-pairs default.
candidates.inference: Control-versus-many on experiment proportions, or descriptive-only if treated as a screen.
candidates.graph: Outlined bars or experiment dots with mean ± SD.

candidates.scientificMessage: Responding cell types show different Ca²⁺ transient shapes and peak timing.
candidates.design: Responding cells followed longitudinally and nested in imaging experiments.
candidates.primaryContrast: Descriptive trajectory/peak timing, conditional on response.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Independent imaging experiment, approximately n=3 if inference is added.
candidates.inference: Descriptive only unless peak/AUC contrasts are prespecified.
candidates.graph: Four mean ± SD trajectories or small multiples.

candidates.scientificMessage: Specific PLCε domains and catalytic activities are required for rescue.
candidates.design: Independent imaging experiments across WT, negative control, and domain mutants.
candidates.primaryContrast: Each mutant versus PLCε WT, plus ECFP versus WT for rescue context.
candidates.inference: One-way family with prespecified WT-reference contrasts and multiplicity control.
candidates.graph: Experiment dots with mean ± SD and hierarchical WT/mutant labels.

candidates.scientificMessage: Active constructs alter cytosolic PLCδ-PH fluorescence relative to control.
candidates.design: Repeated observations within cells/experiments across six time points.
candidates.primaryContrast: Trajectory or endpoint response of active constructs versus matched control.
candidates.inference: Descriptive trajectory by default; paired summary only with a planned endpoint/AUC.
candidates.graph: Three mean ± SD measured-point-only trajectories with activation annotation.

candidates.scientificMessage: Cyclosporin A and BAPTA-AM suppress opto-RhoA-driven NFAT translocation.
candidates.design: Dark/Lit paired within cells; cells nested in experiments; three treatment groups.
candidates.primaryContrast: Within-treatment Dark versus Lit and DMSO-reference differences in change.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Independent experiment, approximately n=3; cells remain nested.
candidates.inference: Experiment-aware paired/change analysis with prespecified treatment contrasts.
candidates.graph: Paired raw layer plus experiment summaries, or change-score dots.

candidates.scientificMessage: GflB loss prolongs macropinocytic crown lifetime.
candidates.design: Crown events nested in cells and movies across imaging sessions.
candidates.primaryContrast: gflB knockout versus AX2; overproducer versus AX2 secondary.
candidates.inference: Session summaries or hierarchical model with AX2-reference contrasts.
candidates.graph: Unfilled violin/box with raw events and distinct movie/session summaries.
candidates.sampleSize: 109 synthetic event rows; published allocation needs confirmation.

candidates.scientificMessage: GflB loss redistributes actin toward the detergent-insoluble fraction.
candidates.design: Independent fractionation experiments with linked soluble/insoluble fractions.
candidates.primaryContrast: Knockout versus AX2 within each fraction; insoluble likely primary.
candidates.graph: Grouped experiment dots/bars with genotype on X and fraction as series.

candidates.scientificMessage: Early mitosis increases the soluble fractions of K5 and K14.
candidates.design: Independent fractionation experiments with linked K5/K14 readouts.
candidates.primaryContrast: Early mitosis versus interphase separately for K5 and K14.
candidates.inference: Two prespecified phase contrasts with multiplicity handling.
candidates.graph: Grouped experiment dots/bars or facets by keratin.

candidates.scientificMessage: Kinase/substrate combinations have distinct phosphorylation kinetics.
candidates.design: Independent kinase experiments across 3 kinases, 2 substrates, and 4 times.
candidates.primaryContrast: Descriptive trajectories; endpoint or AUC only if prespecified.
candidates.statisticalUnit: Independent in-vitro kinase experiment, approximately n=3.
candidates.inference: Descriptive only for the main trajectory unless the user specifies a summary contrast.
candidates.graph: Small multiples by kinase with K5/K14 series, or a six-series overlay.

candidates.scientificMessage: K5 phosphorylation peaks align with mitotic-phase composition after release.
candidates.design: Independent synchronized-cell experiments with linked readouts across time.
candidates.primaryContrast: Descriptive temporal alignment; traces are not exchangeable groups.
candidates.inference: Descriptive only unless an association or lag hypothesis is supplied.
candidates.graph: Aligned facets separating phospho-signals from phase fractions; no misleading dual axis.

semantics.series: two traces within each readout family
